title: Bill Maher Accuses Trump of Socialism and Slams Democrats
description: Recent reports highlight Bill Maher's criticism of Donald Trump's business deals and his comments on Democratic socialists.

sections.heading: Comments on Donald Trump
paragraphs: According to The Hill, Bill Maher stated that Donald Trump is further left than Democrats, citing an Intel stake and calling it 'socialism'.
The Independent reports that Maher accused Trump of embracing 'socialism' over Nvidia and Intel deals.

sections.heading: Stance on Democratic Socialists
paragraphs: KABB reports that Bill Maher slammed Democratic socialists. These comments were made as more far-left candidates continued to get elected.
